option_relations.rationale: Acute compartment syndrome is a broader category that includes acute bilateral anterior compartment syndrome with rhabdomyolysis and bilateral peroneal nerve palsy.
Bilateral acute compartment syndrome is a broader category that includes acute bilateral anterior compartment syndrome with rhabdomyolysis and bilateral peroneal nerve palsy.

Non-traumatic acute bilateral compartment syndrome with rhabdomyolysis is clinically equivalent to acute bilateral anterior compartment syndrome (exertional) with rhabdomyolysis and bilateral peroneal nerve palsy, as the vignette describes non-traumatic exertional causes and the symptoms align.
Rhabdomyolysis is a component of the leaf diagnosis, but the leaf diagnosis also includes compartment syndrome and nerve palsy, making rhabdomyolysis a supertype of only a part of the leaf.
